title: Jon L NDE 4759
content: After experiencing a 'non-survivable' heart attack, I passed out while being loaded into a helicopter for transport to a hospital. While not conscious, I remember lying in a hospital bed that seemed to be sitting at the beginning of chrome rails starting at the foot of my bed extending into infinity. The ceiling was navy blue with multiple white crosses. I was lying in bed at approximately a forty-five degree angle. Once, I looked up at the ceiling and the crosses were twisting. I felt I needed to make my bed move down the chrome rails. I was very happy. I felt completely like the only thing that mattered was myself. I felt completely absorbed within myself and absolutely nothing was important at all - not money, not sports cars, not even my mother whom I had always cherished my entire life. I felt it was ultimately ridiculous to think anything on Earth or anything that was material was in any way important at all. It is not. Next, I saw that I was standing beside my bed and looking at myself lying there. I was several feet away. Then, I heard a nurse screaming repeatedly, 'Hey! I'm not getting a breath here!' She keep yelling loudly and repeating the statement. Even though I seemed to know it was going to hurt, I decided just to take one breath just to get her to be quiet. When I did, I immediately returned to life experiencing a lot of pain and being angry with the nurse for making me come back to pain and earthly problems and experiences. There should be absolutely no fear of death. I was feeling wonderful and very resentful that I had to wake up.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Standing several feet away beside the bed, looking at himself lying there.

environment.environment_other_detail: Hospital-bed-like setting: bed at start of chrome rails extending into infinity; navy-blue ceiling with multiple white crosses (twisting).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He took a breath 'just to get her to be quiet' after hearing a nurse scream she was not getting a breath.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived hospital-bed setting with chrome rails extending into infinity; heard nurse shouting; chose to breathe and returned.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He first perceived an environment while 'not conscious' (lying in a bed with rails), then had an OBE (standing beside the bed), then returned by choosing to take a breath.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Hospital bed at the beginning of chrome rails extending into infinity; navy-blue ceiling with multiple white crosses that were twisting.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Nurse screaming repeatedly: 'Hey! I'm not getting a breath here!'
